# SARIF schema provenance

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the unmodified SARIF 2.1.0 JSON schema downloaded from the [OASIS standard distribution](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json).

- Retrieved: 25 October 2026
- SHA-256: `ad6db49878699b091f3eeb765b6e29e92a34bad4da88664d000c923b549c3a25`
- Standard: [Static Analysis Results Interchange Format (SARIF) Version 2.1.0](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/sarif-v2.1.0-os.html), OASIS, 27 March 2020
- Copyright and reuse terms: the notices in the linked standard apply to this third-party schema.

The schema is retained locally so format tests do not require network access. The test validator is a development dependency and is excluded from the distributed tool's runtime dependencies.
